curated.name: Rooted meadow-sitter
curated.reading: Ingrain puts down roots that feed the user but stop it fleeing, Curse trades speed for toughness, and Amnesia steadies its resistance. Together they describe a lineage that stops following the sun and roots instead, the reverse of 3.1's 'stays on the move'. Fits rich, reliably sunny meadows where staying put pays.
curated.behavior: Settles into one sunny patch for weeks and won't be moved.

curated.name: Lullaby bloom
curated.reading: Grass Whistle is a soothing melody that puts the listener to sleep, Charm softens an attacker, and Safeguard protects against status harm. A lineage that pacifies rather than fights, extending the calming aroma of 3.8 to sound. Fits meadows shared with many large grazers, or a homestead.
curated.behavior: Hums and wafts scent until the quarrel around it stops.

curated.name: Shade bramble

curated.behavior: Sits low in the undergrowth and lashes out with vines.

curated.name: Scree hunter

curated.behavior: Hunts along cliff edges, sending stones down before it follows.

curated.reading: Mud Sport and Muddy Water both cloud things with mud, and Foresight picks out what is hidden. A lineage of murky, still water that hides in its own silt and still finds its prey, the Wartortle habit of stalking from hiding taken further. Fits shallow, muddy ponds and marsh pools.

curated.name: Mist-lake elder
curated.reading: Mist shrouds the user in fog, Aqua Ring wraps it in a veil of water that slowly heals, and Refresh clears poison, burns and paralysis. A lineage built for slow recovery and long life rather than fighting, which suits a line famous for longevity. Fits cold, misty highland lakes where individuals live long enough to grow algae on their shells.
curated.behavior: Slow, rarely seen, and very old; heals rather than fights.

curated.behavior: Hits first and hardest, then withdraws into its shell.

curated.name: Storm capacitor
curated.reading: A store-and-release lineage: Charge builds up power for the next electric move, Bide absorbs punishment and returns it doubled, and Reversal hits hardest when it is nearly beaten. It is the cheek-pouch canon (pent-up energy released in one burst) made into a fighting style. Fits exposed ridges and hilltops with frequent thunderstorms, where charge comes easily.
curated.behavior: Holds back, soaks up, then releases everything at once.

curated.name: Kin keeper
curated.reading: A caring lineage built on the Platinum canon of recharging a weakened companion: Wish heals whoever is in its place next turn, Present can heal or harm, and Encore holds an attacker to one move while others act. Fits dense forest groups where weak members are kept going rather than left.
curated.behavior: Stays close to injured groupmates; tends rather than flees.

curated.name: Spark-sparrer
curated.reading: Play-fighting kept into adulthood: Fake Out startles, Double Slap is a contact contest of quick light blows, and Tickle weakens without injuring. Low-harm moves that settle disputes, like Pichu's tail-touching tests of courage. Fits large, crowded groups where real fights would be costly.
curated.behavior: Settles rank with sparring rather than shocks.

curated.analogy: Many small songbirds mob predators in groups, harassing them until they leave.

Together they extend the ten-minute dives of the canon. Fits deep, cold open water where prey is far down and scattered.

A lineage that defends a fixed patch, like a dense flowerbed, from browsers and flower thieves rather than hunting. Fits crowded meadow and garden edges where its blooms draw trouble.

curated.name: Sleeping lure
curated.reading: The scent lure with a sedative behind it: Sleep Powder puts the animal it has drawn in to sleep, Cotton Spore slows anything that tries to leave, and Mind Reader makes the next strike certain. A sit-and-wait trap that needs no venom to work. Fits sheltered pond margins where prey come to drink.
curated.behavior: Lures, drugs and only then strikes; rarely needs to chase.

curated.behavior: Basks more and lures less; hits hard once when threatened, then retreats to recover.

curated.name: Sand-trap lurker
curated.reading: Three moves that all stop prey getting away: Sand Tomb traps it in sand, Mud Shot and Scary Face slow it. Gible's pounce-from-the-nest canon turned into a whole strategy. Fits sandy or silty cave floors where prey passes the nest mouth.
curated.behavior: Stays at its nest hole longer than most Gible; holds what it catches rather than chasing.

curated.name: Wind-cutter
curated.reading: A lineage that attacks at range from the air: Twister whips up wind and Dragon Breath can paralyse. It is the move version of the Platinum folklore that its wings cut blades of wind. Fits open high country where prey is spotted and hit from a distance.
curated.behavior: Strikes from the air without closing in; leaves flattened brush where it hunts.
curated.note: Built partly on a folklore entry (445.3).

curated.name: Clumsy rampager
curated.reading: Gible's clumsiness made into a temperament: Thrash and Outrage are multi-turn rampages that leave it confused, and Double-Edge hurts the user. A lineage that wins by overwhelming force and pays for it. Fits crowded nesting caves where fights between neighbours are short and violent.
curated.behavior: Fights in frenzies; often injured, rarely beaten.

curated.name: Reading jaw
curated.reading: A lineage that hunts with its jaws: Mind Reader makes the next move certain to land, and Bite and Crunch put the jaws, otherwise absent from the line's own list, behind it. Aura reading plus a sure bite is the shape of an ambush hunter. Fits forest edge where prey moves under cover.
curated.behavior: Waits until it has read the animal's next movement, then bites once.

curated.name: Pack shield
curated.reading: A guardian lineage: Follow Me draws attacks onto itself, Detect dodges them, and Iron Defense hardens it to take what gets through. It pairs with Riolu's aura alarm: one animal hears the fear and stands in front. Fits open mountainside where a group with young must cross exposed ground.
curated.behavior: Moves toward a frightened groupmate and takes the threat on itself.

curated.name: Nest-raiding pair
curated.reading: The Platinum pair tactic carried in the blood: Fake Out makes a guarding parent flinch, Spite wears down its defences, and Assist lets either partner use the other's moves, so the decoy and the thief can swap roles. Fits snowline forest where tree-nesting birds breed.
curated.behavior: Works in twos; one draws the parents off while the other takes the eggs.

curated.name: Rime sprinter
curated.reading: A first-strike lineage: Ice Shard always goes first, Crush Claw tears and weakens the target's defence, and Double Hit strikes twice. A hunt decided in one rush. Fits open snowfields and ice where prey sees you coming and only speed works.
curated.behavior: Short, explosive chases across open snow; gives up fast if the first rush fails.

curated.name: Cave-mouth tracker

curated.behavior: Checks every crevice; never lets a fleeing animal go.

curated.name: Glacier relict
curated.reading: The most Mamoswine-like Swinub: Icicle Spear fires icicles in a volley, the tusks-of-ice canon in move form, and Ancient Power is the very move a Piloswine needs to evolve. A lineage that carries its own evolution trigger from the egg. Fits permanent ice, the habitat its ancestors thrived in.
curated.behavior: Grows into a Mamoswine without help; keeps to the coldest ground.

curated.name: Moraine rammer
curated.reading: Piloswine's charging made heavier: Double-Edge and Body Slam are full-weight hits, and Rock Slide brings down stones. A lineage of rocky glacial debris where a charge sends rock tumbling. Fits moraine slopes and scree below ice fields.
curated.behavior: Charges harder and more often; loose rock comes down behind it.

curated.name: Frost-ground breaker
curated.reading: A digger for the hardest ground: Fissure splits the earth, Mud Shot throws wet soil, and Curse makes it slower but stronger and tougher. A lineage that breaks frozen soil to reach buried food, building on Swinub's frozen-ground nose. Fits permafrost tundra where food lies under a hard crust.
curated.behavior: Slow, methodical, leaves cracked and turned ground behind it.
